description: This file defines the MilvusVectorStoreConfig class, which manages configuration and request/response transformations for Milvus vector store operations, including environment validation, URL construction, and response parsing.

classes.name: MilvusVectorStoreConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Milvus vector store, handling environment validation, URL generation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and updates headers with the Milvus API key from parameters or environment.

methods.name: get_auth_credentials
methods.description: Returns authentication credentials including the API key for Milvus.

methods.name: get_vector_store_endpoints_by_type
methods.description: Provides API endpoints for read and write operations.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps optional parameters for OpenAI to Milvus-specific parameters.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for Milvus API from environment or parameters.

methods.name: transform_search_vector_store_request
methods.description: Generates embedding for the query and constructs the search request for Milvus via Azure AI Search API.

methods.name: transform_search_vector_store_response
methods.description: Parses the response from Azure AI Search API into standard vector store search results.
